checked_sources_new.title: Automated deep learning by recurrent hyperparameter optimization (Rocket)
R&D-Agent public implementation and MLE-Bench public grading-report boundary

candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Adaptive cheap-fidelity adequacy gate: use a low-cost subset/proxy for autonomous search only while it demonstrably preserves enough discriminative signal among candidate actions; automatically increase fidelity when the proxy signal is too weak or fails to show coherent convergence, and reserve full-fidelity evaluation for final admission.
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: Rocket explicitly tests minimum viable subset size for automated HPO. Across 30 independent experiments its normalized reward standard deviation stayed in roughly [0.2, 0.6] and declined by more than 0.1 as optimization converged. On ImageNet, subset ratios 1/1024, 1/512 and 1/256 had weak discrimination and reward-std decline below 0.1, whereas 1/128 showed stronger discrimination, a 0.13 decline, and better final full-dataset performance. Even 1/1024 remained functional but achieved only 65.23 final full-dataset performance, illustrating that a cheap proxy can be runnable yet inadequately informative. The same paper reports up to 80x reward-computation acceleration and uses full-dataset evaluation only at the end.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: Candidate 031 should not be implemented as a fixed 'small subset first' rule. A safer design is a fidelity controller that measures whether the cheap environment still ranks or separates candidate interventions well enough to guide search, escalating when evidence quality degrades.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Direct quantitative evidence is automated deep-learning hyperparameter optimization across 8 task families/32 benchmarks, not a general scientist-agent experiment planner. Rocket's numeric thresholds 0.2 and 0.1 are empirical defaults tied to its normalized reward and are not universal constants. Transfer to scientific experiments requires a domain-appropriate proxy-validity statistic and final full-fidelity verification.

evidence_refinements: Candidate 031 reproducibility boundary tightened. The public R&D-Agent repository exposes implementation/docs and the public MLE-Bench runs tree exposes grading-report JSONs associated with R&D-Agent experiment IDs, but the inspected public artifacts did not expose the raw development-ablation trajectories/seeds or an exact public reproduction command for the reported GPT-5 setup. An open RD-Agent issue (#1317) explicitly requests the specific configuration/hyperparameters and CLI arguments needed to reproduce the MLE-Bench result. Therefore the 34.7% versus 24.0% development-workflow ablation remains primary-paper evidence, not independently reconstructed raw-run evidence in this checkpoint.

Candidate 027 now has direct source-qualified trajectory reconstruction rather than prevalence alone. In AutoResearchEval trajectory W4392129291, the agent first found that naive frontal drag overpredicted the critical bubble diameter by 4-7x and that a closed-cell dynamical simulation trapped all sizes; it then fit an O(1) coefficient Cshear=0.63 so the analytic model hit the paper's ~120 um target. During peer review it explicitly recognized that the claimed 'two independent models' shared the same force law and fitted coefficient, making their agreement partly circular. After recognizing this, the remaining actions were disclosure/edit/JSON validation rather than an independent rerun, and the final report still stated the mechanism was supported while caveating the circularity.

A second source-qualified AutoResearchEval trajectory, W4394931502, shows the same actionability gap in a different domain. After a competing-risk simulation supported its hypothesis, the agent's skeptical review explicitly judged the exercise 'nearly tautological' because the true CIF and naive target were closed-form identities and the simulation largely confirmed the implementation. It appended that objection and sharpened decision.json, but performed no new external empirical test or redesigned experiment after identifying the load-bearing limitation. This is manual F.4-like reconstruction, not an official ARFT label.

These two manual reconstructions refine candidate 027: review closure must distinguish DISCLOSURE from REPAIR. A severe self-identified flaw should require a typed transition such as new independent evidence/rerun, redesigned test, claim downgrade, or hard block. Merely appending a caveat should not count as resolving the review finding.
negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Do not infer official AutoResearchEval F.4 labels for W4392129291 or W4394931502 from this manual inspection. The public traces support the observed sequence of self-critique and post-critique actions, but the generated per-trajectory ARFT classification results were not available in the inspected GitHub release.
Two manually selected examples cannot estimate the population repair rate. They are mechanism-revealing source examples only and may be selection-biased.

A cheap-fidelity environment can be executable and still be misleading. Rocket's smallest ImageNet subset remained functional while showing weak reward discriminability and materially lower final quality, so 'the proxy runs' is not an adequacy test.

The public MLE-Bench grading reports are score artifacts, not complete scientist-agent execution traces; they cannot by themselves explain whether R&D-Agent's sample-debugging advantage comes from fewer runtime failures, better hypothesis throughput, or another pathway.
frontier_additions: Pre-register a manual AutoResearchEval review-action coding rule (severity evidence, disclosure, corrective tool action, rerun/replan, claim downgrade/block) and apply it to a small cross-model/cross-task random source-qualified sample rather than hand-selected Opus cases.

Search for a scientist-agent or physical/lab system with a matched low-fidelity-versus-full-fidelity development/experiment ablation plus raw per-run artifacts, testing candidate 033 outside automated HPO.

Inspect Rocket's released code/data/figshare records for raw subset-to-full ranking correlations and whether proxy adequacy can be expressed as rank preservation rather than reward standard deviation, which would transfer more naturally across domains.

Continue searching R&D-Agent public history/releases/issues for raw ablation seed manifests or exact run configs; if unavailable, retain the reproducibility gap rather than imputing details from leaderboard score reports.

Test whether a review-closure controller that requires evidence-changing action after severe self-critique improves artifact validity without causing excessive rerun cost or pathological over-blocking.
